basics.name: Adrian Capraru
basics.label: Head of AI & Automation. Production AI agents for finance and accounting operations.
basics.summary: Builder-operator who takes AI systems from zero to production and runs them, in finance, accounting and operations. Took an accountancy firm's 20-module SaaS from first commit to live production in 10 days, behind 3,000+ automated checks. Founded 3Descu and grew it from 5 printers in an apartment to a 200+ printer factory, turnover x65 in three years at a 57% net margin. Former FinTech COO who led operational and compliance readiness for an EU crowdfunding (ECSP) licence. 6 years in FinTech product and operations plus 2 years shipping AI automation in production. Works human-in-the-loop by design: evals and regression gates, audit trails, confirm-first agent actions, and client ownership of every system.

work.name: M.A. Whately & Co.
work.summary: Irish chartered accountancy practice. Leads the firm's automation function: the systems the firm runs on and the automation it delivers to its clients.
highlights: Took the firm's multi-tenant client SaaS from first commit to live production in 10 days (23 Sep to 3 Oct 2026): 20 modules, 3,000+ automated checks, an 87-point deploy smoke test on every deploy.
Built an EU-hosted AI bills reader at 99.8% field accuracy on a synthetic test corpus, for under one cent per document, posting to Xero with VIES checks and SEPA payment files.
Rebuilt the practice's client-management system: 587 client records migrated, a 97-field schema cleaned, 3,172 writes with 0 failures, dashboards for 10 staff and the owner.
Automated month-end prepayment journals for a tour operator, validated 107/107 against the bookkeeper's own entries, live daily since 16 Oct 2026.
Productised a SEPA payment-file converter sold as a monthly subscription.

work.name: Independent practice (Upwork and direct)
work.summary: Top Rated on Upwork with a 100% Job Success Score: 22 contracts, 12 of 12 rated contracts five stars, one client rehired four times, all work inbound.
highlights: Automated deal-to-invoice-to-payment from HubSpot to Xero across 3 legal entities and 4 currencies, live since April 2026 with 212+ invoices (direct engagement).

Built an EU-sovereign, multi-tenant financial reporting platform for the education sector, tenant isolation proven by automated tests (52/52 sign-in e2e, 5/5 RLS mutation tests); each phase at or under budget.
Automated daily revenue reporting for a five-hotel group, matched to the accounting team's figures cell by cell.
Built a self-improving, regression-locked LLM pipeline for industrial PLC code migration; five stars plus a bonus.

work.name: 3Descu (TREIDESCUPRINT SRL)
work.summary: On-demand 3D printing manufacturer for engineering buyers across Europe. Founded on an EU start-up grant; runs strategy, production, sales, finance and every line of the software.
highlights: Grew from 5 printers in an apartment (2022) to more than 200; turnover x65 in three years to about EUR 190K in 2025 at a 57% net margin, up 75% year on year (public filings).
2,000+ orders from 1,600+ buyers in 30 countries; 45% of orders ship to Germany; one in three orders from a returning customer; rated 4.7/5 by 200+ verified buyers.

Shipped the quoting-to-fulfilment platform solo with AI coding agents in under five months: 929 commits, ~400 merged pull requests, 38 edge functions, 4 languages, 120+ release checkers (~260K assertions per run).
Shipped one of the first manufacturing MCP servers, listed in the official MCP Registry (io.github.cadi27tech/3descu-quote).
Zero-budget press launch: 10 articles in national, regional and international trade press within a week.
ISO 9001:2015 certified company; ranked 1st in Gorj county in 3 ListaFirme Topul Firmelor 2026 categories (professional and design services).

work.name: Systemartis
work.summary: Bucharest AI systems studio, team of 4. Leads the automation practice: agents, workflow automation and custom software for B2B operations teams.

work.name: Innovium
work.summary: Own consumer-products brand with a registered EU trademark (9 classes) and 66+ products on eMAG. About EUR 50K revenue in 2025, profitable. Built the pricing and order automation (courier labels, e-invoicing).

work.name: HighCrowd
work.summary: EU real-estate crowdfunding platform. Led operational and compliance readiness (penetration testing, documentation, architecture review with the regulator) for the platform's EU crowdfunding (ECSP) licence, granted by ASF in March 2024.
highlights: Designed investor onboarding on LemonWay with KYC and AML checks, cutting onboarding from about 45 to 8 minutes per investor (internal measure).

work.name: InRento
work.summary: Managed investor communications and the migration plan through the 2022 EvoEstate-InRento merger (12,000+ combined investors). Produced the platform explainer video (14K+ views).

work.name: EvoEstate
work.summary: Pan-European real-estate crowdfunding aggregator (6,700 investors). Promoted from Community Manager to Product Manager within 8 months; owned the roadmap and the secondary market. Produced the platform explainer video (25K+ views).
